A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 30-page ROADWork paper, including Appendices A–D. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that manuscript content is identical apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments on work-zone segmentation, discovery, sign reading, scene description, and pathway prediction in Tables 2–8, with further evaluations in Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original experimental results in Tables 2–8 and Appendix C, including evaluations of models trained on ROADWork.

M1.justification: The reconstruction pipeline, video label propagation, crop-rescaling, object-context conditioning, and YNet pathway prediction procedures are identical.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage is unchanged, including ROADWork, discovered BDD100K and Mapillary work zones, adverse-weather and bus-camera subsets, and common-dataset evaluations in Appendix C.

E2.justification: Every corresponding comparison retains the same methods, including segmentation and detection models, text-reading systems, VLMs, geographic-adaptation methods, and pathway baselines.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, data-selection procedures, model configurations, training schedules, and experimental controls are identical throughout the main text and appendices.

E4.justification: Both versions contain identical analyses of manual versus pseudo masks, geographic adaptation, label unification, model size, forgetting, pathway curvature, and prediction failures.

E5.justification: No repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty-reporting practice, or statistical estimation procedure is added, removed, or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings are identical. For example, both report 39.0 AP for Mask DINO with video propagation in Table 2 and pathway ADE of 22.68 for YNet with ROADWork segmentation in Table 19.

T1.justification: Mathematical content is unchanged, including the angular-error formula and threshold-based metric definition in Appendix C.3. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion are identical, retaining the same dataset, benchmark, foundation-model performance, and simple-technique claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are identical, including explanations of generalization and captioning behavior, pathway failure conditions, missing camera calibration coverage, and incomplete capture of traversable paths.

D1.justification: Data-processing details in Appendix B, implementation settings in Appendix D, and project/resource links are unchanged. Updating the arXiv version link introduces no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The reference list and research positioning in the introduction and Appendix A are identical; no cited work or novelty relationship changes.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v2, 22 Jul 2025 to v3, 4 Nov 2025. Manuscript wording, headings, paragraph order, and appendix structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, and manuscript layout are unchanged. Rendered-page differences are confined to the version/date stamp, with no visual evidence added, removed, or rearranged.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves the same scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations, and presentation across the paper and appendices. The version/date stamp and associated link update provide no meaningful improvement or deterioration in paper quality.
